area: Skein Urchin AI (UrchinAutopilotConfig_Skein, SkeinController nose row)
summary: Urchin run1, trained in the real game with time_ai_search.py, replaced the Skein autopilot numbers and the nose pair (1.39 at 14.41/s instead of the lead off at the fleet lag). On 36 fresh flights a side the shipped AI DNFed every I4 race and the trained one finished all 36 (I1 79 -> 53 s, I2 143 -> 77). The old values are in the checklist entry for a revert.
